source.handoff_revision: The commit containing this checklist adds only examples/checklist documents on top of implementation_commit. Resolve its exact SHA from Git; do not substitute a health or local merge SHA.
source.compatibility_evidence: Workflow verifies unchanged composer.lock, original P12 read-v2 contract, owner routes and P04/P05/P09 controllers/scope/presentation against base. No shared owner API behavior is rewritten.

input_verification.method: Container byte length and SHA256 comparison against uploaded manifest.json
input_verification.not_claimed: Windows ZIP/B12 image and the full references folder were not uploaded as bytes in this chat. No ZIP completeness, visual acceptance or immutable runtime-overlay certification. The detailed mixed-list textual spec is available and implemented.

contract_and_query.query: source/q/status/date_from/date_to/timezone/sort/per_page/cursor; optional warehouse_id assertion; earlier keyword alias retained with conflict validation.
contract_and_query.caps: per_page 1..100 default20; normalized search <=200 characters; fixed 900-second cursor; date picker today-90..today in Vietnam.
contract_and_query.sort: NULLS LAST, requested created_at direction, source_rank ASC, ID ASC. Rank INBOUND1 OUTBOUND2 WARRANTY3.
contract_and_query.time: created_at for each canonical source; half-open local calendar day filter. All dates omits bounds and may include older rows. Stored timestamp precision is preserved; null never synthesized.
contract_and_query.search: Unicode NFC/NFD equivalence and Vietnamese case-insensitivity tested on PostgreSQL and SQLite; accents preserved. Explicit type terms plus permitted stock partner/code fields. Warranty customer fields excluded even with PII permission.

data_acl_cache.identity: resource_type, source and canonical UUID; row_key SOURCE:UUID, p12.identity and exact existing GET read_target. Detail target revalidates ACL.
data_acl_cache.status: Canonical source_status retained, separate null mini_app/readiness/display_status with explicit availability. Source-qualified canonical filter options only for authorized sources. No fullscan/SCANNING -> waiting/approval inference.
data_acl_cache.counts: DOCUMENT_LIST_RECORD. DB totals/four facets before cursor/LIMIT; source tab affects total but not facet source selection. DENIED null differs from authorized empty0.
data_acl_cache.scope: Fresh active actor, confirmed server warehouse context, stable session, existing owner permissions and persisted warranty ownership before search/count/page.
data_acl_cache.errors: No partial list/total if an authorized source required for facets fails. No false empty. 403 denied; 409 changed context; 410 cursor expired; 422 malformed query/body/cursor; 503 disabled/unavailable.
data_acl_cache.cache: No internal result cache; private no-store/nosniff. No stale stock-only version serving warranty data.
data_acl_cache.snapshot: Counts and rows share a single-response DB snapshot; snapshot_consistent=false between requests. Newer-created rows excluded by signed watermark, backdated inserts/deletes/status edits may change totals. Restart to refresh.

source_test_evidence.route_cache_command: php artisan route:cache; php artisan test tests/Feature/P12MixedDocumentsTest.php --log-junit mixed-route-cache.xml; php artisan route:clear
source_test_evidence.environment: Disposable PostgreSQL p12_contract_test at localhost and SQLite memory, with APP_ENV testing; test fixture setup is not live seed authorization.
source_test_evidence.quality: PHP syntax, Pint on eight changed PHP files, JSON parse and locked Composer audit PASS; audit reported no advisories.
source_test_evidence.reports: Required nonempty successful XML assertions are printed with SHA256 in workflow log/job summary. No artifact quota fallback masks missing tests.

schema_index.explain: Read-only EXPLAIN on isolated data recorded in source test log; production-volume query plan/index change requires separate review.

open_decisions.question: Approve localized/common badges and filter presentation?
open_decisions.proposal: Keep canonical source-qualified labels until an approved mapping; display_status remains explicitly unavailable.
open_decisions.impact: FE must not render waiting/approval labels from SCANNING/readiness.

open_decisions.question: Is customer-name search/display required in aggregate?
open_decisions.proposal: Keep it outside v2 aggregate; use existing authorized P09 detail.
open_decisions.impact: Any expansion needs a separate privacy-reviewed owner contract, not unmasking current PII.

release.procedure: Obtain explicit release approval, verify exact artifact bytes/overlays/SHA/locked vendor/tier/schema/routes. Enable only the approved environment, then smoke GET-only using existing nonempty/empty/denied records and pagination. FE integration and device/back/focus/scroll checks follow separately.
release.rollback: Disable aggregate flag or return to previously approved code/config release. No new schema or stock effects to reverse. Preserve owner receipts/dedup/history.
release.restrictions: No seed/repair/restore, business write, P19 enablement, automatic deploy, bypassed security gate or production activation.
